# RoundRobinInteractionVersion

A version of a round-robin interaction.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `agents` | [`InteractionAgentBinding`](interaction-agent-binding.md)`[]` | The participants, in the order they take turns. |
| `isNoActionAllowed` | `boolean` | Whether an agent may pass its turn without saying anything. |
| `isVotingAllowed` | `boolean` | Whether an agent may put something to a vote. |
| `isDirectQuestioningAllowed` | `boolean` | Whether an agent may ask another a question directly. |
| `isSolutionProposalAllowed` | `boolean` | Whether an agent may propose a final answer for the others to vote on. With no one able to, a conversation with a person carries on until it is stopped. |
| `humanSettings` | [`RoundRobinInteractionHumanSettings`](round-robin-interaction-human-settings.md)`\| null` | Whether a person takes part in the conversation, and how. Null: no one does. |
| `maximumNoActionLoops` | `integer \| null` | How many rounds in which every agent passes end the run. Null: no limit. Constraints: range: 1..2147483647. |
| `externalOperationsMcp` | [`McpExternalOperationBinding`](mcp-external-operation-binding.md)`[]` | Tools from MCP connectors that every agent in the interaction can call, as well as its own tools. |
| `externalOperationsOpenApi` | [`OpenApiExternalOperationBinding`](open-api-external-operation-binding.md)`[]` | Tools from OpenAPI connectors that every agent in the interaction can call, as well as its own tools. |
| `inputsConnectorAuthenticationSecret` | [`ConnectorAuthenticationSecretInput`](connector-authentication-secret-input.md)`[]` | Run inputs that choose the secret a tool sends with its calls. |
| `inputsConnectorBinding` | [`ConnectorBindingInput`](connector-binding-input.md)`[]` | Run inputs whose values go straight into a tool's calls, so the model never sees or chooses them. |
| `inputsPrompt` | [`PromptInput`](prompt-input.md)`[]` | The inputs a run is started with, which the prompt uses as `%%name%%`. |
| `prompt` | `string` | What the agents are asked to do. A run's inputs are filled in wherever it says `%%name%%`. |
| `solutionSchema` | `string \| null` | The JSON Schema the answer must match, as JSON text: the run's output is then JSON of that shape. Null: the output is free text. |
| `systemPromptMode` | [`InteractionSystemPromptMode`](interaction-system-prompt-mode.md) | How `systemPrompts` combine with the instructions Maitento gives every agent. |
| `systemPrompts` | `string[]` | Extra system instructions for every agent in the interaction. |
| `durationWarningToAi` | `timespan \| null` | How long into a run the agents are told that time is running short. Null: they are not told. |
| `durationAutoTermination` | `timespan \| null` | The longest a run may take. The run stops with an error when it is reached; time spent waiting for a person does not count. Null: the interaction sets no limit. |
| `contextSettings` | [`InteractionContextSettings`](interaction-context-settings.md) | How the conversation is kept within the model's context window, and how many rounds of tool calls an agent may make in one turn. |
| `loom` | [`LoomConfiguration`](loom-configuration.md)`\| null` | Long-term memory for the interaction's agents. Null: no memory. |
| `swarm` | [`InteractionSwarmSettings`](interaction-swarm-settings.md)`\| null` | Whether this interaction's participants may start sub-interactions, which ones, and how far the work may spread. Null: none may. |
| `credentialStack` | `string \| null` | The credential stack this interaction's runs use, by id or name, when their start doesn't name one. Null: the namespace's default stack, then your tenant's. |
| `version` | `integer` | The version number, from 1. Every change to a definition adds a new version with the next number. |
| `date` | `datetime` | When this version was created, in UTC. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | Whether this version is disabled. A disabled version is never used: new links and runs take the latest enabled version, and anything pinned to this one fails until it is re-enabled. |
